title: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages
slides: Can an AI agent live in your texts?
Dozens of startups now embed agents inside SMS threads
They read every message—even your private ones
You can book, order, and schedule without apps
Which one deserves your phone number?
thread_text:
1. AI Now Reads Your Texts

Dozens of startups are embedding AI agents directly inside SMS threads. They see every message, including private ones.

2. The Agent in Your Pocket

These agents don't need an app—they live in your messages. They can book, order, and schedule for you.

3. Privacy at What Cost?

To work, they read everything. That means bank alerts, medical info, personal chats. Are you comfortable with that?

4. Which One Gets Your Number?

With so many options, picking an agent is like choosing a new friend. But this friend has access to your entire digital life.

5. Test It Yourself

Download one of these agents and try a simple task. Does the convenience outweigh the privacy risk? Only you can decide.

instagram.caption:
Dozens of startups now put an AI agent inside your SMS thread—it reads every message, including private ones.

No app to install. You just text it and it books, orders, and schedules for you. 💬

But to do that, it sees your bank alerts, medical info, and personal chats. 📱

If you write or publish for a living, your work conversations may now pass through an agent you never chose. ⚠️

Would you hand your number to something that reads everything you send?
